A new SRM prospect has been classified as a WARM / PASSIVE lead.

{{ $('payment claimed to be made').item.json['Situation Response'] }}

WHY THIS LEAD MATTERS

This person has already responded to our SRM campaign and provided their details. Their decision not to request direct follow-up does not mean there is no opportunity.

This lead can potentially be:

• Softly nurtured toward SRM
• Re-engaged at the right time
• Introduced to other Heart2Heart Enterprise programmes that may be a better fit
• Invited into relevant H2H communities and initiatives
• Educated about H2H and the value of our programmes
• Developed into a stronger future prospect

The objective is to build a relationship and create future conversion opportunities without applying unnecessary sales pressure.

NEXT STEP

No immediate direct outreach is required.

Please retain this lead in the H2H database and consider them for future nurturing, community engagement, SRM conversion, and other relevant H2H offers.

Our advertising spend has already brought this person into our ecosystem. The opportunity now is to nurture that relationship and create value from the lead over time.
